reviews.review:
a love letter to your emo phase from a distance of a 30+ millennial in form of a zine-like visual novel with rhythm game style songs

art shines, songs are nice and compliment the story, and the story itself is great and does not overstay it's welcome. i completed the game only for one ending and liked that ending, so I will keep it that way. song sequences were cleverly done, although i still haven't figured out how to interact during sing-along part, so failed them all, which was kind of in-character. the language change in one of the songs was very cool!

tone-wise it feels like playing an indie version of "life is strange", but very personal one, and i mean this in the best way possible. i don't think this game aims to be a commercial hit, i think it aims to be held close to the heart, and that's where it belongs
